title: MCP specification (2025-11-25) tool definition
applies_to: tools/list Tool objects, independent of any model provider

rules.title: inputSchema must be a JSON Schema object
rules.rationale: The spec says inputSchema MUST be a valid JSON Schema object (not null).

rules.title: Tool name should be 1-128 characters without spaces or commas
rules.rationale: Tool names SHOULD be between 1 and 128 characters and SHOULD NOT contain spaces, commas, or other special characters.
